text: Second fix shipped (ckpt 3550) and the engine restarted on it. Root cause of the stalls: the mid-scan re-read of stale prices waited on the scanner's lock, which a running scan holds for 5-7 min. That froze the engine loop (the stall at ~8,800 scanned) and left bets refused as 'no price in 3 minutes'. It now uses the lock-free requote. The watchdog false positive (24 restarts) is also fixed. Next: trim Novig reads on far/hopeless markets with evidence, then check volume vs. quality.
